test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 9 Sept 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Five people A, B, C, D and E are sitting around a circular table. One of them is facing outside (opposite to the centre) and the other four are facing the centre. C is facing the centre and is sitting at second place to the left of D. B is sitting at second place to the right of D. A is sitting to the immediate left of both C and D. E is sitting to the immediate right of B. Who among them is facing outside?
solution:
1) C is facing the center and is sitting at second place to the left of D.

2) B is sitting at second place to the right of D.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5187430be8b82a4bb5fe74303899296a5aa4394495a62b4550c0b4c5062680dc.png] 

3) One of them is facing outside (opposite to the centre) and the other four are facing the centre.

4) A is sitting to the immediate left of both C and D.

5) E is sitting to the immediate right of B.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/82349d81a8ed4606ed502d933d8ca1509e3192a66c886aa39e1c96dad83e371a.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"D"**.
